_about: Vocabulary confirmed by the supplied material. Each row names the evidence it rests on. Nothing here is inferred from general knowledge of the franchise.

evidence.sourceText: Ratings include S, SS, SSS, SR, SSR, with extensible categories.

ratings.orderNote: sortOrder follows the order in which the client listed them. It is a display order, not a confirmed ranking.

guideStatistics._about: Stat terms exactly as the status guide words them. They are kept apart even when two may be the same stat (e.g. 'final damage' and 'final damage dealt'); merging is the client's call.

rows.name: defenses
rows.note: Plural group term as written in the guide. Which defenses it covers (physical, strategy, both) is not stated.

rows.name: final damage
rows.note: As written under Dispirited State. May or may not be the same stat as 'final damage dealt'.

rows.name: final damage dealt
rows.note: As written under Pyroblast state and Fury Shield. May or may not be the same stat as 'final damage'.

formations._about: In-game positions. English names: 'Support' is printed on the ninja card; 'Center' and 'Vanguard' are the client's wording. Spanish names are printed on the in-game formation screen.

evidenceRule.sourceText: Support, Center, Vanguard describe formation positions (rear, middle, front). All Support units primarily use Chakra; Center/Vanguard primarily use Force. Future teams contain four ninjas; max 3 Support, 2 Center, 1 Vanguard.

roles._about: Source categories: the labels the reference forum files ninjas under. They are NOT the in-game formation. Every mapping below is a PROPOSAL awaiting the client's approval; until then a category resolves to no formation.

rows.name: supporters
rows.mappingNote: One data point: 'Uchiha Madara (Moon's Eye)' is filed under 'supporters' and its card prints Formation: Support. Not yet confirmed as a general rule.

rows.name: assaulters
rows.mappingNote: Unproven. The names differ ('assaulters' vs 'Center') and no card of a ninja filed under 'assaulters' has been supplied.

evidence.sourceText: The Discord channels are named supporters, assaulters, vanguards [...] Assaulter = Center is not proven.

rows.name: vanguards
rows.mappingNote: Same word as the formation, but no card of a ninja filed under 'vanguards' has been supplied.

evidence.sourceText: The Discord channels are named supporters, assaulters, vanguards

statusCategories._about: Structural facets used to classify dictionary entries. Spanish labels are interface wording, not game terms.
